Some themes have an issue where "blank flairs" appear next to the title of unflaired submissions. This only affects the comment page. It occurs when the sub has a base flair styling which includes padding. Here's what it looks like (it's that little box directly left of the title).

The reason this happens is the HTML still has a span.flair, even though it's empty. It's very simple to fix using the CSS3 selector :empty. Add this line of code after your flairs:

.flair:empty { display: none; }

Alternatively, you can change the selector of your base flair style from .flair {... to .flair:not(:empty) {...

I first noticed this while implementing flairs on /v/Cashmere and I've seen it other places.
